verdicts.reason: A: the 'Pick your sound' eyebrow has dropped below the body copy. The 'Obsidian One, $349' label floats over a detached shadow ellipse, far from the headphones. The 'Obsidian Buds' label has turned into a fake pill next to the CTA, the earbuds have shrunk to an icon, and the headphones are small and jammed against the right edge. B has the same broken reading order and loose labels, plus worse problems: the CTA and Buds label are tiny and barely legible, the earbuds are just two dots, the oversized headphones are cropped at the bottom and right edges, and the logo is off-axis from the left-aligned headline, so it loses on hierarchy and fidelity.
